C1.worst_defect: The hero sub-copy frames the product for developers ("open-source headless commerce framework") before it tells a shop owner what staff do at the counter; the till screenshot and "Point of sale for Vendure" carry it otherwise.

C2.worst_defect: The 'Live demo or your own store' table says the demo "sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com" without saying who or what wcpos is, so an honest disclosure reads as an unexplained third party.

C3.worst_defect: Scanning at the counter depends on a developer adding a ProductVariant 'barcode' custom field, a migration and filling every barcode in the Dashboard ("If your store has no such field, add one to ProductVariant in your Vendure config"). Step 8 'Sign in and make a sale' also has no picture of the sign-in screen.

C4.worst_defect: At the till weaves version and demo caveats into the cashier steps ("On plugin 0.3.0 the till cannot refund", "Refund at the till (live demo only)", "On plugin 0.3.0, Order details has no customer note. On the live demo…"). Troubleshooting puts counter notices next to GraphQL tallyResolveNeedsAdmin and VENDUREPOS_WEB_ALLOW_LAN_HTTP, so staff must sort what applies to them.

C5.worst_defect: The cashier-sheet and closure screenshots sit in oversized framed boxes with wide empty padding, so the images look small and unfinished next to the clean text.

C6.worst_defect: Long code-heavy paragraphs (permission lists, "^20.19 || >=22.12", "packages/vendure-plugin/CHANGELOG.md") break mid-token and make phone reading slow; the phone hero till crop shows only two products.

C7.worst_defect: Quick start LCP is 2.6 s (Lighthouse perf 97); everything else is clean: all 200s, unique titles, JSON-LD, no overflow, llms.txt and search live.

overall_worst.defect: At the till mixes plugin-0.3.0 limits and live-demo-only steps into the cashier instructions ("On plugin 0.3.0 the till cannot refund", "Refund at the till (live demo only)", "On plugin 0.3.0, Order details has no customer note. On the live demo…"), so staff reading it on a phone can't tell which steps work on their own store.
overall_worst.fix: Open the page with one 'On your own store (plugin 0.3.0)' box listing what the till can't do yet (refunds, customer note), write the cashier steps for the real store only, and move the demo-only refund steps to a separate collapsed 'On the live demo' section.
